devdoc.details: Adapted from AilgnsOtcEscrow.sol. One deployment per supported TOKEN_B.

params.duration: Seconds until expiry, between 10 minutes and 30 days.
params.sellFlgns: true: escrow FLGNS; false: escrow TOKEN_B.

params.amount: Gross escrow quantity; the taker receives amount less its 0.4% fee.
params.maxPay: Maximum gross payment, including per-fill price rounding; no fee is added on top.

devdoc.title: FLGNS OTC escrow V2: 0.4% from each received asset

FEE_BPS().notice: 0.4% of each side's gross received asset, rounded down separately per fill.

fill(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Pay the maker and receive the escrow asset in the same transaction.

refundExpired(uint256[]).notice: Anyone may trigger expiry refunds; escrow always goes to the original maker.

userdoc.notice: Makers escrow one asset; takers pay and receive the other asset atomically.         Makers may cancel; anyone may return expired escrow to its maker.         No administrator, upgrade, pause, arbitrary approval, or asset withdrawal function.
